description: Declarations and contents with jsonschema's verdicts, for a renderer that checks them without a JSON Schema engine, or with another one. Each verdict is on the binary64 reading of the instance, as JSON.parse reads it, so an integer beyond 2^53 is checked as the nearest binary64. schema view means schema/definitions/view.schema.json#/$defs/view, dataQuality schema/extensions/dataQuality.schema.json, neuroschema.schema.json the root schema schema/neuroschema.schema.json, a path with a slash that path under schema/; any other schema is a file in schema/views/. Only valid binds an implementation; errors list each failing keyword and instance path jsonschema reports.
